notes.title: We put a Clicker Game inside Carball360!
notes.content:
Punch is a Clicker Game, in which you click on fruit to make a punch! 

In Punch, you click to gain punch!!

Click until you simply can't click anymore!!!

mouse and controller friendly... yup.

notes.title: Easter Main Menu Mini Game
notes.content:
